messages:
Jordan: Heads up — planning a quiet-window apply tonight 23:00 UTC for release v2.14. Changes: k8s-egress NAT rules, shared IAM role switch for analytics, and a provider pin for aws 5.1 -> 5.2. Requesting pin+rollback plan sign-off.
Sam: +1 on timing. How long is the window?
Jordan: 60m guardrail. If anything blocks, we abort and hand back to next-day window.
Leila: Do we have migration steps for the analytics role change? Might affect event ingestion consumers.
Nia: Analytics team ran a dry-run earlier, no consumer diffs, but they flagged an old service-account that needs deleting after cutover. Will coordinate post-apply.
deploy-bot: terraform plan completed for infra/waveset:
```
# summary
+ resources to add: 7
~ resources to change: 3
- resources to destroy: 0
changed provider: aws 5.1 -> 5.2 (pinned in module)
```
Jordan: Plan looks safe. Noting provider pin — Sam, can you verify we're using the module version we tested in staging?
Sam: Confirmed: module@v1.8.2, tested with aws provider 5.2 in staging, no drift.
onthread note: @oncall-sre was paged earlier for a different incident but should be back by 22:30 UTC.
oncall-sre: I'm back, I'll watch logs and networking during the apply. If latency spike > 150ms for inference routes, I will trigger rollback.
Leila: Add a deploybot mute rule for noisy resource changes? Last time we got a bunch of infra alerts during terraform state sync.
Jordan: I'll set a 10m alert-suppress window in Ops before apply.
deploy-bot: apply-preview: serial apply will run in this order: 1) iam/roles 2) network/egress 3) infra/k8s-egress-routes 4) analytics-role-swap. Canary is enabled for k8s-egress in us-west-2.
Sam: For the canary, what percentage?
Jordan: 10% traffic shadow to canary route for 15 minutes then ramp to 50% over 10 minutes, full after health checks pass for 30m.
Nia: If analytics swap fails, we should be able to revert role alias within 5 minutes. Keep ready the old role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/analytics-legacy
Leila: Also ensure service-account deletion is gated behind a separate PR — no automatic destroy in this apply.
Jordan: Agreed, we will remove the SA after monitoring.
deploy-bot: Starting apply at 23:00 UTC in 3..2..1
Sam: Kicking off terraform apply now (observability: https://console.internal/runs/2791203456)
oncall-sre: Watching egress metrics — baseline 12ms, ready.
deploy-bot: Step 1/4 complete: IAM role updates applied.
Nia: Verified role switch for analytics consumers. No error spikes in the next 2 minutes. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Step 2/4 complete: Network egress rules updated (NAT gw replacements in us-west-2).
Leila: I'm seeing a couple of ephemeral 5xx in event-proxy logs, small spike, looks like warmup.
oncall-sre: Latency up to 80ms briefly, not near rollback threshold. Continuing.
deploy-bot: Step 3/4: k8s-egress canary enabled at 10% — healthcheck passing.
Sam: Canary ok for 10m, continuing to ramp.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 50% complete, health stable for 12m.
Jordan: Proceeding to final rollout. Leaving a manual hold point for analytics swap; Nia to confirm before final step.
Nia: Confirmed. Proceed with analytics swap.
deploy-bot: Step 4/4 complete: analytics role alias switched.
Leila: Post-apply: I still see that old service-account referenced in a helm values file in staging. Will raise a follow-up PR to delete after 24h.
Sam: Noted. Running smoke tests for ingestion.
oncall-sre: Smoke tests passing. No SLO violations.
Jordan: Great work team — we'll keep enhanced monitoring on for 6 hours and then close the window. If anyone sees anything odd, ping here and we'll triage.
Leila: Adding release notes line: "Update: provider aws pinned to 5.2; NAT egress replacements; analytics IAM role migration (no downtime)."
Nia: Also adding runbook note about role rollback ARN and SA deletion delay.
Jordan: Closing thread — thanks. :tada:
